questions.stem: A mechanic opens a disconnect and applies a lock before replacing a motor starter. No one tests the conductors. What critical step is missing?

Ask another employee whether the circuit is usually supplied from one source
Wear rubber gloves instead of verifying deenergization
Rely on the disconnect handle position because visible open position proves zero energy

The option 'Wear rubber gloves instead of verifying deenergization' does not apply the controlling principle for deenergization and verification to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Rely on the disconnect handle position because visible open position proves zero energy' does not apply the controlling principle for deenergization and verification to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

options: 5.0 A (amperes)
2.88 A (amperes)
0.20 A (amperes)
2,880 A (amperes)
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Using Ohm’s law, I = V / R = 120 V / 24 ohms = 5.0 A (amperes).
incorrectOptionExplanations: This value does not result from the voltage-to-resistance ratio.
This reverses the relationship or divides resistance by voltage.
This result is three orders of magnitude too large for the stated values.

options: 144 kW

This result is high by a factor of ten.

options: 80 ohms
360 ohms
120 ohms
180 ohms
